title: DNA OS ↔ n8n Workflow Control Connection
scope: Existing DNA OS → n8n outbound webhook/router, workflow classification, DNA OS-side owner resolution, dispatch/evidence path, credentials reference, observed runtime, and configuration drift. No new workflow, endpoint, credential, listener, or connection is introduced.

security.rule: Secret values are never recorded. Only credential reference names, resolver metadata references, and transport/auth behavior are recorded.

boundaries.destination: n8n workflow classifier and loop guard

boundaries.output_result: AgentDispatchResult with task ID, status, evidence refs, next action, and owner decision requirement

data_flow.outbound: DNA OS central event → fixed HTTPS POST → n8n classification/loop guard → RouterDecision in response
data_flow.resolution: DNA OS reads route_group, resolves capability and agent from its own registries, then creates a controlled gateway task
data_flow.authority: n8n never resolves owners, checks policy, dispatches, reads credentials, or calls back; DNA OS owns those gates
data_flow.evidence: DNA OS records every hop, decision, resolution, dispatch status, and evidence reference in its evidence store
data_flow.current_runtime: Declared remote target is unreachable; observed local :5678 is reachable but unmanaged and not proven as DNA OS's target

authority.n8n: Classify structured events, enforce workflow loop guard, return route_group and route metadata
authority.dna_os: Resolve capability/agent, read permission requirements, create work, enforce policy/admission/write gates, dispatch, and persist evidence
authority.credentials: Reference-only Keychain metadata; the outbound webhook sender does not use the declared API credential
authority.configuration: Fixed N8N_BASE_URL is the source of outbound target truth; drift is reported, not silently repaired

overall_gaps: Configuration drift: declared Hostinger target is unreachable while local :5678 is observed without DNA OS ownership or wiring.
No evidence proves the registered n8n API credential authenticates the observed local instance.
Outbound webhook path is historically live-verified but currently blocked by target reachability drift.
No inbound n8n-to-DNA OS callback/listener is wired.
The n8n workflow can be live in historical evidence while current runtime identity remains unresolved.
next_required_connection: If separately authorized, reconcile the declared endpoint with an Owner-controlled/supervised n8n instance and verify the existing credential against that exact instance. Do not repoint the sender or create a workflow in this documentation task.
